[Design System] This project uses the **拾页 · Reader Kit** design system. This is a binding choice for visual style — every visual must follow it. Don't invent colors, type, spacing, or components not grounded here.

Scope: the design system is a visual style reference only. Its guide may describe example products, brands, or people unrelated to the user and to the subject of this conversation. Never treat anything in the design system as a fact about the user, their work, or the topic.

**Loading the bundle is how you use this design system.** Every page you build must load `_ds/reader-kit/_ds_bundle.js` and compose with the components it exports on `window.ReaderKit_4d7f19` — do not recreate those components from scratch or restyle raw HTML to look like them. The bundle calls `React.createElement`, so `window.React` and `window.ReactDOM` must load first — the pinned tags below provide them. Add these once:

```html
<!-- React first — the bundle calls React.createElement -->
<script src="https://unpkg.com/react@18.3.1/umd/react.development.js" integrity="sha384-hD6/rw4ppMLGNu3tX5cjIb+uRZ7UkRJ6BPkLpg4hAu/6onKUg4lLsHAs9EBPT82L" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>
<script src="https://unpkg.com/react-dom@18.3.1/umd/react-dom.development.js" integrity="sha384-u6aeetuaXnQ38mYT8rp6sbXaQe3NL9t+IBXmnYxwkUI2Hw4bsp2Wvmx4yRQF1uAm" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="_ds/reader-kit/tokens/foundation.css">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="_ds/reader-kit/components/core/components.css">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="_ds/reader-kit/styles.css">
<script src="_ds/reader-kit/_ds_bundle.js"></script>
```

With several design systems bound, keep each system's stylesheets together and load the PRIMARY system's `<link>`s LAST so its tokens win.

The bundle is plain compiled JS — load it with a regular `<script>` (no `type="text/babel"` or `type="module"`). Every component is then available on `window.ReaderKit_4d7f19` — e.g. `const { Button, Tag } = window.ReaderKit_4d7f19;`. The linked stylesheet(s) carry the design tokens (colors, type, spacing) — style against those via `var(--*)` and the design system's classes rather than guessing values.

Your own page code stays separate from the bundle: write it in `<script type="text/babel">` blocks, with Babel standalone loaded once (pinned tag below) to transpile your JSX in the browser —

```html
<script src="https://unpkg.com/@babel/standalone@7.29.0/babel.min.js" integrity="sha384-m08KidiNqLdpJqLq95G/LEi8Qvjl/xUYll3QILypMoQ65QorJ9Lvtp2RXYGBFj1y" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>
<script type="text/babel">
  const { Button, Tag } = window.ReaderKit_4d7f19;
  ReactDOM.createRoot(document.getElementById('root')).render(<Button />);
</script>
```

In text/babel blocks, never give a top-level binding a window-global name — `status`, `name`, `open`, `close`, `top`, `self`, `parent`, `origin`, `event`, `length`, `location`, `history`, `screen`, `scroll`, `stop`, `print`, `focus`, `blur`, `frames`, `closed`, `opener`. Babel injects the transpiled code as a classic script (top-level const/let become var), so `const status = …` writes `window.status`, which coerces or misbehaves, and the page dies with an error the console may never show. Use a longer name (`statusBadge`, `openItems`).

<design-system-guide>
# 拾页 · Reader Kit

这是 008 baoyu-design 能力演示中原创的微型设计系统，并非上游自带品牌。参考上游 Reader App 示例需求，围绕阅读、收藏和筛选建立三种界面方向。编译、检查、导入和预览由上游原版工具执行。

## 内容与视觉规范

中文动作直截了当：保存文章、标为已读、清空筛选。示例文章均为本项目原创演示内容，不代表实际抓取或推荐。界面以白色阅读区域、深墨色文字和紫色动作构成。品牌色 #5144ce，主文字 #222338。色彩变量见 tokens/foundation.css；间距 8/16/24px，圆角默认 14px。阴影仅用于工作台浮层；主题变化通过 CSS 变量覆盖，不在组件内硬编码主题色。

字体使用系统界面字体及 Microsoft YaHei；没有下载品牌字体，没有字体文件依赖。正文字号 16px，辅助文字不低于 12px。文章阅读页采用衬线标题和宽松行距。按钮悬浮轻微变暗、按下位移 1px；不添加循环动画。线框方向隐藏内容封面色彩并采用虚线边界，杂志方向采用双列卡片，专注方向采用紧凑列表。

## 组件与素材

- Button：主动作、次级动作、低强调动作及禁用状态。
- Tag：分类、辅助信息、成功状态。
- 图标由演示页面中少量原创线条图标提供，不作为第三方图标系统发布。无 emoji、摄影或生成图片。封面用 CSS 几何图形表达文章分类，不冒充真实素材。
- foundations.html 展示颜色与排版；components/core/index.html 展示两个真实编译组件。

## 来源与复现

上游 https://github.com/JimLiu/baoyu-design ，版本 026d4ea012bdd5cada72ac8cc13f21ba4edf2245。编译产物不可手改，应运行上游 compile-design-system.mjs；preview.html 由 build-preview.mjs 生成。
</design-system-guide>

Per-component usage notes follow — the first lines of each component's `*.prompt.md`. These are NOT bound into `_ds/reader-kit/`, so they're reproduced here (full files live in the source tree above):

<ds-prompt-excerpts>
### components/core/Button.prompt.md
Button：页面动作使用此组件；主动作采用 primary，次级动作采用 secondary。

```jsx
<Button label="保存文章" onClick={save} />
```

### components/core/Tag.prompt.md
Tag：显示内容分类或实验状态的短标签。

```jsx
<Tag label="设计" tone="accent" />
```
</ds-prompt-excerpts>

Prop contracts per component (from each `.d.ts`). Prop names are exhaustive — do not invent props. Enum props list every allowed value; `*` marks the default. Never pass a value outside these lists:

<ds-component-props>
Button — label: string · variant: primary | secondary | ghost · disabled: boolean · onClick: function
Tag — label: string · tone: accent | neutral | success
</ds-component-props>

CSS tokens: the exact `--*` names are defined in the stylesheet(s) linked above. The 15 custom properties they define are:

--accent, --accent-ink, --accent-soft, --body-size, --canvas, --ink, --line, --muted, --radius, --shadow, --space-lg, --space-md, --space-sm, --success, --surface

Only use `var(--*)` names from that list. Never guess a token name — an unresolved `var()` silently falls back to the browser default.
